notes.title: Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] To enhance the game's stability, the Ren'Py engine has been updated to the latest stable version.
[*] The volume of music and sound effects has been adjusted for a more comfortable experience.
[*] The soundtrack in some scenes has been changed to better convey the atmosphere.
[*] A button for accessing the achievements section has been added to the main menu.
[*] Minor graphical issues have been fixed.
[/olist]

tags.feature: A button for accessing the achievements section has been added to the main menu.

tags.bug: Minor graphical issues have been fixed.

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] [b]Optimized text skip mode.[/b] The feature is now more precise and user-friendly.
[*] [b]Refined visual elements.[/b] Subtle issues have been fixed to enhance the overall visual atmosphere.
[*] [b]Improved text and storytelling.[/b] Specific sections have been edited for greater narrative clarity and atmosphere.
[*] [b]Updated English translation.[/b] The localization is now more accurate and better conveys the original tone.
[/olist]
